intro: Beasts of Thunder Ridge is a quest in Orgrimmar given by the leatherworker Kamari, who supports the ongoing expansion of the Horde capital. Adventurers are dispatched to the crags of Thunder Ridge to harvest durable lizard hides and provide cured pelts to reinforce the city's newly erected structures.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orgrimmar is always expanding, adventurer. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
